name: AftLife -Shoujo to Neko to, Ushinawareta Sekai-
original_name: AftLife -少女と猫と、失われた世界-
source:
There is room in small house. A girl's name is Arisa, she is muttering.

"……I'm hungry"

A cat's name is Tis, she is amazed.

"Duh, you just had breakfast?"

A girl is laugh in easy everyday, and cry for small things.
Then she reads a book about the outside world,
and grows into an adult step by step.

――This is a story about take one step from the lost world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263610/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一间小屋里，少女亚里沙喃喃自语。

“……肚子饿了。”

名叫蒂丝的猫，一脸无语。

“喂，你不是刚吃过早饭吗？”

悠闲的日常中，少女欢笑，也会为小事落泪。
随后，她阅读描绘外面世界的书，
一步一步地长大成人。

——这是一个从失落的世界中，迈出脚步的故事。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263610/]Steam[/url]]
